Name: RevenueRollup
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: RevenueRollup, command: many)
SELECT region, city, grouping(region, city) AS level, sum(amount) AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, city)
ORDER BY level, region, city;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0:region⟩, ⟨c1:city⟩, ⟨c2 aliased:grouping(region, city)⟩ AS level, ⟨c3 aliased:sum(amount)⟩ AS revenue
FROM sales
GROUP BY ROLLUP(region, city)
ORDER BY level, region, city;

Name: RevenueRollupWithNulls
